routes.//: Security headers on every response. `continue: true` means this rule adds headers and then keeps routing, so it does not swallow the host rules below. Kept in `routes` rather than the top-level `headers` key on purpose: `routes` is the only routing property that is evaluated BEFORE the filesystem, and host-based folder routing depends on that. `rewrites` run after the filesystem, so on quadrillioneuro.com a request for /privacy would be answered by the root (Trillioneuro) privacy.html before any rewrite could redirect it — silently serving the wrong brand's legal page. Mixing the two styles is also rejected by Vercel, so this file commits to one.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://unpkg.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://kxzywyflylkcqoidiqmo.supabase.co https://ipapi.co; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

routes.//: Long-lived cache for the immutable media. hero-bg.mp4 alone is 1.5MB and was being revalidated on every visit.

Canonicalise to the apex host. Both www variants are attached to this project and previously served a full duplicate of each site, while every canonical tag points at the apex — two indexable copies of the same page competing with each other.

Quadrillioneuro's files are physically under /quadrillioneuro/, so they were ALSO reachable at trillioneuro.com/quadrillioneuro/* — a second indexable copy of the whole sister site on the wrong domain, with canonical tags pointing at quadrillioneuro.com. Send those to the real host.

Catch-all for the quad host, with /_vercel/ excluded. Without that exclusion this rule rewrote /_vercel/insights/script.js to /quadrillioneuro/_vercel/insights/script.js, which does not exist — analytics and Speed Insights would have been silently dead on quadrillioneuro.com only, the hardest kind of gap to notice.
── trillioneuro.com clean URLs ── Explicit rather than via `cleanUrls`, which cannot be combined with `routes`.

Retire the .html URLs: they were the only form used by internal links, while sitemap.xml listed the extensionless form — so every internal click was an extra redirect hop and search engines saw two URLs per page.
